start: Exercise page of a lifted exercise with workouts in the last 3 months

steps.action: Open the exercise page
user_sees: A chart card: what it shows (for example 'Heaviest weight') in orange with a down arrow, the Range control, the latest value and its date
must_not: An empty chart while workouts exist
A value in the wrong unit

steps.action: Tap the orange label, pick another choice in the 'Chart shows' sheet
user_sees: The sheet closes; the chart and readout show the new choice
must_not: The old picked point kept with the new numbers

steps.action: Drag along the chart to a point
user_sees: The readout shows that point's value and date
must_not: A value from another day

steps.action: Tap the picked point's label (with the '>')
user_sees: That workout opens
must_not: Another workout opening
Nothing happening

start: Exercise page opened from a live workout (tap the exercise name)

steps.action: Tap the exercise name on its card
user_sees: The page opens with the chart starting on kg lifted per workout
must_not: The live workout lost or closed

start: Treadmill-type exercise whose sets carry speed or incline

steps.action: Open the 'Chart shows' sheet
user_sees: Speed / incline / level choices join the list
must_not: Machine choices shown for an exercise that never logged them

start: Free member (no Plus, no gym plan), the 3-month chart limit switched on

steps.action: Tap the '1Y' or 'All' range
user_sees: The limit pop-up explaining older charts are part of MettleUp Plus, with a way to the Plus screen
must_not: The older range shown for free
The range control stuck on the refused choice

start: An exercise with no workouts in the picked range

steps.action: Pick a range with nothing in it
user_sees: '—' as the value and 'Nothing in this range yet', no chart drawn
must_not: NaN, 0 or a flat line drawn from nothing

start: Exercise page chart after a workout of it is deleted

steps.action: Pick the point from that workout, then delete the workout and come back
user_sees: The point is gone and the readout shows the newest remaining point
must_not: The deleted workout still drawn or still openable

steps.action: Switch the choice and back
user_sees: The picked point is cleared each time
must_not: A picked point left from the other choice

steps.action: Look at the chart
user_sees: Built only from the member's own workouts on this phone
must_not: Another member's data drawn
Older months locked away for a gym member whose plan is active
